candidates.name: Discoid lupus erythematosus
support_spans: Symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques on the cheeks and temples
candidates.why: The patient's skin lesions are consistent with discoid lupus erythematosus, which often presents with symmetric, annular plaques on the face and scalp.

candidates.name: Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus
support_spans: Multiple millimetric erythematous to hyperpigmented monomorphic keratotic papules involving the head, trunk, and extremities
candidates.why: The patient's skin lesions are also consistent with subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus, which often presents with papules and plaques on the trunk and extremities.

candidates.name: Systemic lupus erythematosus
support_spans: Raised levels of antinuclear antibodies (>1:160)
Positive: anti-Smith antibodies, SSA/Ro antibodies, SSB/La antibodies, and anti-U1RNP antibodies
candidates.why: The patient's laboratory results, including the presence of antinuclear antibodies and specific autoantibodies, suggest an autoimmune mechanism consistent with systemic lupus erythematosus.

candidates.name: Lupus nephritis
support_spans: Moderate proteinuria
candidates.why: The patient's laboratory results, including moderate proteinuria, suggest a possible renal mechanism consistent with lupus nephritis.

candidates.name: Lupus erythematosus
support_spans: Biopsy Findings: Slightly atrophic epidermis with interface dermatitis, individual dyskeratotic keratinocytes, and a superficial perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of neutrophils
candidates.why: The patient's biopsy results, including interface dermatitis and a superficial perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of neutrophils, are consistent with lupus erythematosus and would be decisive in confirming the diagnosis.

candidates.name: Discoid lupus erythematosus
support_spans: Direct Immunofluorescence: Negative results
candidates.why: The patient's negative direct immunofluorescence results are consistent with discoid lupus erythematosus and would be decisive in confirming the diagnosis.
